Background: Silverpine provides analytics and compliance tooling to institutional clients (risk/treasury teams). Heavy PD/PII; must satisfy data residency (US/EU), long retention for audit trails, and allow key control for legal holds. Procurement pushing private deployment rather than hosted.

- Data residency: Option to pin control plane + runtime to EU (Frankfurt) for EU customer data.

Success criteria: SAML SSO working end-to-end, SCIM provisioning syncs users/groups within 24 hours, RBAC prevents access to sensitive models, KMS integration with key access logs.
